scope: CLI admitted snapshot reacquisition decorator; exact source and model-free actual call-path tests
confirmed_boundaries: The real resolver executes once before comparison; NoResult conversion preserves adapter name/config_id and the exact output cost.
Only a nonempty valid batch with unique IDs and exactly one existing Evidence per ID can be considered.
Every record is re-admitted through the current resolver/request/ExternalEvidenceAdmissionPolicy before complete normalized Evidence equality.

Changed or revoked source authority, higher minimum rank, different effective interval, different provenance/scope, future retrieval, malformed/mixed/duplicate/empty/new batches are not silently suppressed.
Later valid retrieval does not change the original observed/effective age; normalized admitted equality is distinct from raw retrieval-clock equality.
CandidateRevision and HumanReviewRequired remain PolicyDenied, and an inner Timeout cannot be hidden by cached evidence.

Actual run_investigation_resolution with nonempty existing claims/receipts preserves the entire artifact byte-for-byte and the existing Accept or Unknown verdict; each new attempt has zero admitted IDs and zero new verification receipts.
Repeat execution remains an idempotent source read and still consumes one resolver call and fixture-reported cost; no refund or new source/claim authority is asserted.
limits: This is source review plus local native macOS Rust controls, not the exact future Linux image or both final arm binaries.
Existing normal coverage/materialization may use previously admitted facts through unchanged gates; the NoResult action itself grants no new admission.
A future source/image/proof/receipt must be independently reviewed before real provider requests; this result cannot authorize that workflow.
No model accuracy/F1, CLI adoption, publication or release conclusion is made.
